original_test_intent: Install the approved supported OS onto exactly one designated M.2, boot from it without M.2 errors, and—where the applicable tower front HDD LED exists—verify it is off during a defined no-I/O interval.
original_method: Validate signed media and stable target serial/WWN/NVMe ID, execute the approved partition/boot/encryption plan with complete logs, reboot through KVM/recovery control, prove boot source and storage health, then have an operator capture idle LED state.
manual_activity: User approves media, exact target and data-loss/boot/recovery contract; operator/KVM confirms physical target and boot and observes conditional front LED; agent only assists with approved install and evidence.
required_inputs: Signed OS installer media/version/checksum/license and support matrix
Exact target M.2 serial/WWN/NVMe ID and all-drive exclusion inventory
Partition, encryption, filesystem, UEFI/legacy boot and boot-entry policy
Data-loss authorization, backup, KVM/console, recovery image and maintenance window
Front HDD LED applicability/vendor definition, idle condition and qualified operator
safety_requirements: Identify target by stable hardware ID and re-confirm immediately before destructive write
Protect all non-target drives and verify backup/recovery/KVM
Stop on target ambiguity, signature/support mismatch, unexpected partition, installer or boot/storage error
Do not select by device order, repartition/reboot repeatedly or erase recovery artifacts
Operator records LED only under explicit no-I/O condition and does not infer it from OS state
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete drive/boot baseline and validate approved media/target
Run only approved installer options and capture full install/boot/storage evidence
Verify designated M.2 boot source and OS health after one approved reboot
Do not choose/format another disk, handle media/LED physically, auto-recover/retry or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve exact target, destructive scope, media and boot policy
Review install/boot/LED evidence and issue PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A non-executable summary only; it lacks stable target selection, media verification, exact partition/boot options, recovery and physical LED acceptance.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the signed installer only against the re-confirmed stable M.2 ID using approved partition/boot/encryption parameters, preserve full logs and verify post-boot source and health.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Single-M.2 primary OS install, reboot/boot, M.2 error check, conditional tower front HDD LED-off at idle and 10/20 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an identity-locked destructive deployment record with full installer/boot evidence and separately governed physical idle-LED observation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds provenance, target protections, deterministic boot/recovery and measurable idle LED conditions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: OS visibility cannot replace proof of boot source or physical LED state.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Installer naming can change across boots and front-panel activity may aggregate other storage, so stable IDs and a verified no-I/O window are essential.

project_override_considerations: If the platform is not a tower or lacks the front HDD LED, applicability must be recorded; the checkpoint is not silently failed or fabricated.
expected_evidence: Approval, media signature/checksum and support matrix
All-drive inventory and exact target stable IDs
Pre/post partitions, encryption, boot entries and designated boot-source proof
Complete installer, reboot/KVM, OS/kernel/driver and storage health logs
No M.2 errors in complete system/SEL evidence
Applicable idle-condition telemetry plus front HDD LED photo/observation, recovery notes and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently requires OS install/boot and conditional physical LED evidence; GPT V2 supplies missing safety and identity controls.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Execution awaits project media, target and recovery inputs, while static review is complete.

review_improvement: Makes the destructive M.2 deployment identity-safe and recoverable while retaining boot, error and conditional physical LED coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Block-device names are enumeration artifacts and can reorder, so a destructive installer must bind the target to serial/WWN/NVMe identity. A successful install also does not prove firmware boot selection, and an LED-off claim is valid only when all storage I/O is demonstrably idle and the LED's scope is known.
